purpose: Inspect vehicle and sub-FSM transition evidence, live state, history, snapshots and optional AI narration.
primaryGoal: Explain how a selected vehicle entered a state by inspecting filtered transitions, triggers, historical signals and previous-snapshot differences.

dataSources.behavior: Selected vehicle; independent live polling; AbortSignal forwarded. Hook declares VehicleState but actual response is an envelope. Page casts through unknown and reads state while ignoring envelope observation freshness and verified fields.
Positive numeric ID gated; polling and cancellation; active_subs is live in-memory FSM state, not range-filtered. Backend can return enabled:false without active_subs.

vehicle_id, fsm_name except all, hours, page, per_page, encoded start/end. Query key includes all bounds and pagination; polling and cancellation. Router passes parsed bounds to repository and returns data,total,page,per_page. Repository half-open filtering was not inspected.

Enabled only for a selected/previous transition and positive vehicle ID; empty signal CSV requests all signals. Values, source layer and age are preserved in inspector/copy JSON. No live snapshot is requested without selection despite the page comment.

Opt-in stream scoped by vehicle/from_unix/to_unix; shared AI gate; disabled for invalid window; source change resets stream identity. Main router constructs and injects handler; delegated route mount and backend narration capability were not inspected.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace selection and header View settings
dataSources.behavior: Global vehicle selection; vehicle timezone; fsm-debugger.range preference with default 7d; both resolved instants forwarded. No duplicate page-level workspace picker. Hook internals not inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page maintains a vehicleStateStyle map while StateBadge and diagram use getStateColor from the shared FSM registry.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use the existing registry/style resolution for the hero; keep state labels and unknown distinct from offline.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: TransitionDetail repeats from/to/trigger/duration metadata also shown in SnapshotInspector. This is useful detail, not permission to remove the section.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse a domain presentation fragment only if full ID, vehicle, guard, timestamps and arbitrary context survive; retain both entry points.

existing: filters stack then wrap at sm
timeline empty actions stack at sm; toolbar wraps

issues.detail: Timestamp-positioned tiny tick controls can overlap for dense transitions; touch-target-overlay does not itself prove separate reachable targets. Empty-state action row does not wrap.
issues.fix: Exercise 320px and dense histories; keep every tick selectable with a nonlossy fallback/detail list and allow long action labels to wrap.

issues.detail: Signal names truncate while values wrap; long machine identifiers may not be fully discoverable on small screens.
issues.fix: Wrap or expose complete identifier text using existing tooltip/detail mechanisms; retain all signal identities.

responsive.viewportAcceptance: Unverified at every requested width; no browser exercised.

existing: Diagram hidden state summary and aria-current

issues.detail: Transition detail toggle has a name but no aria-expanded or aria-controls; selected timeline tick has no aria-pressed/current announcement.
issues.fix: Connect toggle state and stable detail region ID; expose timeline selection semantically through existing Button attributes.

issues.detail: Diff mode dims unchanged signal rows with opacity-40, reducing text/source-badge contrast. Actual composed contrast is unmeasured.
issues.fix: Use restrained semantic diff markers without lowering all text opacity; measure actual light/dark/forced-color contrast.

accessibility.runtime: Keyboard order, focus, screen readers, touch reachability, contrast and reduced-motion behavior unverified.

existing: Three independent live/history source trust wrappers
Fatal error retry without replacing retained data
No vehicle/no state/no active sessions placeholders
AI invalid-scope disablement and feature gate

issues.detail: Snapshot queries destructure only data/isFetching. Selected and previous errors, previous loading and retained/offline trust never reach inspector; failure can become 'No signals captured'. Diff may silently compare without a previous snapshot.
issues.fix: Retain both query objects, derive independent DataState, and pass fatal/refresh/error/retry/previous availability to existing SnapshotInspector. Keep retained snapshots visible.

issues.detail: Timeline chart receives no loading state; diagram receives default empty transition rows during initial/fatal transition load. Unavailable observations can look like a real empty history.
issues.fix: Pass source trust to domain chart/diagram and distinguish static machine structure from unavailable observed overlays.

issues.detail: Empty loaded rows produce 'All FSMs healthy', although evidence is page-scoped and may be empty or unresolved. Historical rows can also drive present-tense stuck claims.
issues.fix: Show no observed health evidence with explicit loaded-page/analysis-time provenance; preserve all existing heuristics and alert categories.

issues.detail: enabled:false from stats and missing active_subs are collapsed into 'No active drive or charge sessions'.
issues.fix: Carry enabled/availability status into the existing sub-FSM panel, separating disabled/unavailable from a confirmed empty session list.

visualIssues.detail: Hero combines large bold tracking-wider typography, saturated state colors and perpetual pulse; map duplicates domain semantic styling.
visualIssues.fix: Use shared role typography and subdued FSM semantic presentation, preserving state prominence without ambient pulse or a new palette.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed-white fills/rings, opacity-50 inactive nodes and ad-hoc heading/body sizes compete with theme-aware surfaces and text roles.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing surface/border/text tokens and role typography; keep all graph nodes, current markers and edge summaries.

visualIssues.detail: Raw heading typography, fixed-white session surfaces and green pulse remain in domain presentation; HealthPanel has similar bespoke heading/alert chrome.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse PanelTitle/Text and existing semantic status primitives; retain session labels, live announcement and timestamps.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed-white toolbar/timeline/inspector sub-surfaces and live pulse repeat inside an outer panel. Reduced-motion handling in global CSS was not inspected.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing control/surface tokens and motion policy rather than independent decoration; browser-check reduced motion.

architectureIssues.detail: unknown double-cast compensates for incorrectly typed live-state hook; server envelope freshness/live/data_source metadata is omitted from the hero.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner corrects existing response type and exposes observation freshness through current trust/status components; no alternative request client.

architectureIssues.detail: FSMTimelineChart receives span hours but no selected start/end. buildFsmTimeline anchors positive hours at Date.now; historical custom windows can return rows in log but plot zero buckets in a current rolling window. Labels use browser-local manual MM/DD/HH:MM rather than vehicle timezone/locale.
architectureIssues.fix: Extend existing domain chart with explicit resolved bounds/timezone and use existing date formatting; preserve bucket tiers, series and server bounds.

architectureIssues.detail: Counter and tooltip label total loaded rows as 'in 24 h', but page defaults to 7d and sends one paginated server page, possibly a custom/all-time range.
architectureIssues.fix: Add explicit source-scope label/provenance props to existing LiveControls; keep separate in-window and loaded-row counts.

architectureIssues.detail: Freeze state does not change hook polling, window anchor or transition derivation; URL at only initializes isLive and is not used to resolve a snapshot independently of selected rows. Window helper and timeline also independently default their anchors to now.
architectureIssues.fix: Define and test intended freeze/permalink semantics, retain all existing controls, use one explicit window anchor, and avoid silently promising a frozen buffer while polls replace rows.

architectureIssues.detail: Distribution, average interval, health, diagram and timeline all derive from loaded transition rows rather than complete range; only operational brief explicitly discloses page scope.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep current calculations and add loaded-page scope to every derived surface; request server aggregates only through a separately assigned integration change, never invent full-range data.

priority.reason: Historical chart window mismatch and missing snapshot trust undermine evidence interpretation; preserve the existing 11 sections before restrained presentation adoption.
